The composition is uncluttered, with no distracting household objects.
Controlled lighting and a coordinated background present the candle as a polished retail product.

That way, I can ensure I'm getting the right information and helping the user effectively. It's interesting how a little detail can make such a big difference in communication! Please upload a photo of the candle so I can feature your actual product and preserve its label.
